oracle_receipts.why: This slice's own record said no oracle could return a verdict on a prose leaf.  That was wrong, and it is the sentence the regression below travelled inside: a coverage reason is a claim about cached wiki text, so an oracle can check whether the claim is true even when there is no number to recompute.  Forty-eight investigators did, and the two leaf classes split cleanly.

It is enumerated here instead, from the instrument, and the slice is reported as having declared its gate late — an honest record rather than a retrofitted prediction.
